main_cause_text: FR high-voltage connector terminal contact resistance (discoloured terminal), re-crimped and re-torqued
established_by: Engineer inspection on 2026-10-29 (discoloured terminal; high contact resistance on the bench). Fix not yet verified by a later launch.
synthetic_generator: The log generator sets FR branch resistance to 26 mOhm against about 8 for the other wheels; it does not separate contact from cable.
roles_note: initiating: the fault that started the chain; contributing: conditions without which it would not have tripped (cold pack, HSA feed-forward above the cold BMS limit); consequence: something that happened because of the chain and is not a cause (the undervoltage trip worked as designed).
